summary_en: Correction to FY3/27 dividend forecast announcement issued on 6 August 2026. Earnings per share revised in Q2 cumulative forecast from ¥62.86 to ¥62.72 (adjustment to prior quarter EPS figure only; full-year dividend amounts not disclosed in this correction notice).
title_en: Correction Notice to "Notice Regarding Revision of Business Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase) for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027" Disclosed on 6 August 2026
translation_en_brief: DaikyoNishikawa Corporation issued a correction notice to its prior-day dividend forecast announcement for fiscal year ending March 2027. The correction addresses an error in the earnings-per-share line item within the consolidated earnings forecast for the Q2 cumulative period (1 April – 30 September 2026). Specifically, the Q2 EPS forecast has been adjusted from ¥62.86 per share to ¥62.72 per share. All other forecast figures—including sales, operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income attributable to parent shareholders—remain unchanged from the original announcement. The full-year dividend amounts and any dividend per share figures are not stated in this correction notice; those details would appear in the original 6 August announcement being corrected.
